g.text: 10C Identify the four printed camera parts
Current P13–P16 parts • compare openings and slots, not colour • views have different scales
P13 — fixed pan base
Four chassis mounting holes in the flat foot.
Raised rectangular servo pocket.
Cable window in the forward end.
P14 — rotating yoke / swivel
U-shaped fork: rectangular tilt-servo opening
on one arm, round pivot hole on the other.
Floor: centre hole and two pan-horn slots.
P15 — camera cradle
Rear plate has four camera mounting posts.
Driven ear: TWO slots and a small centre hole.
Passive ear: ONE plain round Ø5.3 hole.
P16 — passive tilt bush
Small loose tube: Ø5 outside, Ø3.2 bore, 4 long.
Fits INSIDE P15's plain-hole ear.
It is not a washer between the base and yoke.
Both P15 ears have the same outside diameter
Identify the driven ear by its two slots. The plain-hole ear uses P16 and the M3 pivot bolt.
The servo horns are separate bought parts; none of these four prints replaces a horn.
P13 Camera pan base: camera_pan_base_s1.stl | P14 Camera yoke: camera_yoke_s1.stl
P15 Camera cradle: camera_cradle_s1.stl | P16 Camera pivot bush: camera_pivot_bush_s1.stl
S0/S1 candidate • simplified assembly illustration • dimensions in mm • not a fabrication template
